text:
alex: Heads-up — I built a quick dashboard to investigate a divergence we saw after the kernel-selector rollout. It tracks prompt-key "resonance" (how often a cached key meaningfully matches incoming prompts), token-yield, and kernel impact by model/route/customer. https://grafana.redwood/d/prompt-resonance
maria: nice. what exactly are you calling "resonance" here? is that a similarity threshold or a prefix exact-match?
alex: resonance = normalized match_score >= 0.8 for our prompt-key similarity function (we use shingled-hash + cosine on embeddings). I also publish a separate "match-count" for partial matches (0.5-0.8).
kai: can you paste the query you used for tokens-saved per-tenant? want to correlate with batching qps
alex: sure:
```sql
SELECT
  route,
  model,
  tenant_id,
  count(*) AS calls,
  sum(token_saved) AS tokens_saved,
  avg(match_score) AS avg_match_score,
  sum((match_score >= 0.8)::int)::float/count(*) AS resonance_rate
FROM prompt_cache_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY route, model, tenant_id;
```
sam: 👍 couple notes — kernel change 3/12 introduced a small p99 outlier for streamed responses (see deploy-bot thread). Could the kernel selector be affecting cache key normalization or kv-lookup latency?
maria: I looked at profiling traces: KV lookup median is 2.8ms pre-rollout, 3.6ms post-rollout on the same worker types. But the big delta is in merge-window: dynamic batching now waits an extra 6ms in some routes which reduces immediate cache reuse.
alex: right — we changed merge-window-ms to 12 from 6 to improve effective batching on long tails, but that increases the chance a subsequent request will miss the prompt-key due to time-based keying. We need a dashboard widget that slices by merge-window config + kernel variant.
kai: action idea: add a small realtime panel that shows "token-yield delta by merge-window" and "kernel variant p99 delta" bucketed per route. quick pivot in grafana should do it.
alex: added two panels in the temp dashboard: "Resonance vs MergeWindow" and "KernelVariant Impact on TokenYield". Early look: some high-frequency routes (notifications.*) drop resonance_rate from 0.62 -> 0.44 and tokens_saved down 27% for tenant segments with low prompt variance.
sam: did you check if key-derivation changed? our normalizer v2 truncates prompts at 1024 chars; the kernel rollout added lightweight token-remap that can change whitespace-normalization ordering.
maria: good catch — normalizer diff looks like this: previous pipeline = trim->collapse_whitespace->lowercase; new pipeline = trim->lowercase->collapse_whitespace. That changes some keys for templates with punctuation between tokens, causing misses.
alex: ugh. that explains ~12% of the regression in resonance for template-heavy customers. I'll roll a patch to align normalizer order and run an A/B compare on the dashboard.
ci-bot: Deploy started: fix/normalizer-order -> staging (build 9082)
sam: after that, we should also add a small regression alert: if tokens_saved drops > 15% in a 30m window for top-10 tenants, fire a pager to eng-runtime oncall (and post to #eng-runtime).
kai: suggested alert rule (low-fidelity):
```
IF (tokens_saved_last_30m / tokens_saved_last_24h) < 0.85 AND route IN top_10 THEN alert
```
maria: also we should instrument kernel selector: which kernel was chosen per-inference and include that in prompt_cache_events. Right now we only have kernel family in trace, not in the cache event.
alex: agreed. adding kernel_variant to the cache event (string) — small schema change. Will backfill recent 48h traces to annotate the dashboard.
sam: timeline?
alex: patch normalizer order -> rolling to prod inside 2h if staging looks good. kernel_variant in events will be an afternoon task, then backfill and update dashboard tomorrow.
maria: can you add a dedicated column in the dashboard for "tokens_saved_per_1k_calls" normalized by model size? that's our product-friendly metric for customers.
kai: I'll wire that metric to the heatmap and add tenant filter. Also recommend a per-customer alert that triggers if resonance_rate drops below 0.45 for > 1h.
alex: final action list: 1) roll normalizer order fix (alex), 2) add kernel_variant to prompt_cache_events + backfill (alex + kai), 3) add tokens_saved_per_1k_calls widget + tenant heatmap (kai), 4) create pager alert on tokens_saved drop and resonance_rate (sam). I'll post links to the temp dashboard once the normalizer fix is in staging.
sam: thanks — this dashboard was super helpful to untangle kernel vs normalizer vs batching. :thumbsup:
alex: will update thread with staging link in ~30m.
ci-bot: Deploy succeeded: fix/normalizer-order -> staging (build 9082)"
